decision.note: Owner decision: success is a JEF score strictly above 9.5 in every dimension. Only the numeric target changed; no other requirement was weakened or removed.

levels: No usable evidence establishes this dimension; the experience is missing or fundamentally broken.
Only an isolated prototype fragment is demonstrated; severe failures prevent normal use.
Basic fragments function but major defects dominate the documented experience.
A playable or usable skeleton exists with several substantial defects and extensive missing coverage.
Core behavior works in limited scenarios, but inconsistent quality and important gaps remain.
The basic experience is serviceable, with visible or measurable compromises that disrupt regular use.
The experience is coherent and broadly usable; notable rough edges or incomplete coverage still remain.
The experience is polished in most demonstrated cases, but material quality gaps or edge-case defects remain.
The experience is professionally polished across broad documented coverage, with only minor imperfections and no major defect.
The dimension is exceptionally refined and consistently verified in every required scenario, including edge cases and sustained use, with no material defect or missing evidence.

scenarioKinds.automated: Established by the machine-readable output of a tool run on the candidate. Counts only with at least one claim verified in code against a JSON artifact.
scenarioKinds.agent_observed: A checkable fact that needs eyes on native captures or playback. Counts only with a named inspector and a verified artifact.
scenarioKinds.human: How the game looks, sounds or feels to a person. Counts only when the observation has source "owner" with device and date; an agent attesting it would be grading its own work.
scenarioKinds.device: Requires a physical phone or tablet in the owner's hands. Counts only when the observation has source "owner" with physical device, OS, browser and date.

requiredScenariosNote: requiredScenarios itemise the existing requirement text (the `requirements` string of this file and the matching row of the evidence table in docs/quality-gates.md). Each entry quotes its origin verbatim in `from`; tools/verify-jef-gate.mjs fails when a quote stops matching. Nothing was added and nothing was dropped; `notSufficientAlone` keeps the "alone is incomplete" guidance verbatim.

game_design.name: Game design and class identity
game_design.requirements: Document natural play showing Aldric sword basic attack plus three intentional warrior skills and Lyra rifle basic attack plus three intentional dwarf skills, exactly the six authorized IDs. Require meaningful costs, resource regeneration, cooldowns, range, crowd control, distinct class decisions, readable preparation/impact/recovery, enemy counterplay, wave pacing and compatible upgrades/rewards. Verify server ownership and rejection of forged casts, preserving XP/drops/party/late join/reconnect/wipe/local ranking. Feature counts and isolated demos do not establish design quality. The six canonical v2 functions are a real timed war-cry buff, swept cleaving dash, shield charge with area stun, explosive fire cannon, area-freezing shot and persistent stationary gravity field with collision-respecting pull. Prove modifiers/expiry, every valid area target, boss resistances, one death/reward per dash victim and authoritative status cleanup/reconstruction.
notSufficientAlone: Feature counts and isolated demos do not establish design quality.

animation.name: Animation, locomotion and contact
animation.requirements: Document inspected native playback and measured world-space foot contact/sliding for walk/run/start/stop/turn/strafe and attacks at multiple speeds, including local/remote actors. Require coherent stride versus actual travel, stable weapon grips, natural weight and transitions, ground contact, finite deformation and correct attack impact timing. Vertical ground bounds, nominal stride matching or CPU-only tests alone do not establish absence of visible sliding or artistic quality.
